title: A large-scale pipeline for LLM-assisted corpus annotation: variation and change in the English consider construction
abstract: arXiv:2510.12306v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: As natural language corpora expand at an unprecedented rate, manual annotation remains a significant methodological bottleneck in corpus linguistic work. We address this challenge by presenting a scalable pipeline for automating grammatical annotation in voluminous corpora using large language models (LLMs). Unlike previous supervised and iterative approaches, our method employs a four-phase workflow: prompt engineering, pre-hoc evaluation, automated batch processing, and post-hoc validation. We demonstrate the pipeline's accessibility and effectiveness through a diachronic case study of variation in the English evaluative consider construction (consider X as/to be/{\O} Y). We annotate 143,933 'consider' concordance lines from the Corpus of Historical American English (COHA) via the OpenAI API in under 60 hours, achieving 98%+ accuracy on two sophisticated annotation procedures. translated_title: 一个用于大语言模型辅助语料库标注的大规模流水线：英语consider结构中的变异与变化
translated_abstract: 随着自然语言语料库以前所未有的速度扩展，人工标注仍然是语料库语言学研究中的一个重大方法论瓶颈。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了一个可扩展的流水线，利用大语言模型（LLM）实现海量语料库语法标注的自动化。与以往的监督式和迭代式方法不同，我们的方法采用四阶段工作流程：提示工程、事前评估、自动化批量处理和事后验证。我们通过对英语评价性consider结构（consider X as/to be/∅ Y）变异的历时案例研究，展示了该流水线的可操作性和有效性。我们通过OpenAI API在不到60小时的时间内，对美国历史英语语料库（COHA）中的143,933条“consider”索引行进行了标注，在两项复杂的标注任务中达到了98%以上的准确率。此外，基于44,527个真实阳性样本拟合的贝叶斯多项式广义加性模型（GAM）……
tldr: 本文提出了一个基于大语言模型的四阶段语料库自动标注流水线，在60小时内以98%以上的准确率完成了COHA语料库中14万余条consider索引行的语法标注，并通过英语consider结构的历时变异分析验证了其在大规模语料库语言学研究中的实用性和有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a scalable four-phase pipeline for LLM-assisted grammatical annotation of large corpora, achieving 98%+ accuracy in annotating over 143,000 consider concordance lines from COHA in under 60 hours, validated through a diachronic case study of variation and change in the English consider construction.
